metrics.name: Lifecycle greenhouse-gas emissions
metrics.definition: Full lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions per unit electricity generated.

metrics.name: Direct and indirect land use
metrics.definition: Direct and indirect land footprint required per unit of generated electricity.

metrics.name: Annual capacity factor
metrics.definition: Ratio of actual electrical output to maximum potential output over an annual period.

metrics.name: Operational water consumption
metrics.definition: Volume of freshwater evaporated or consumed per unit of generated energy.
